title: Singular personal pronouns
focus: Learn the three subject pronouns for one person.

exercises.prompt: Which Finnish pronoun means “I”?
exercises.explanation: The speaker uses minä (“I”); the listener is sinä (“you”); another person is hän (“he or she”).

optionFeedback.minä: Correct. The speaker uses minä (“I”); the listener is sinä (“you”); another person is hän (“he or she”).
